rules.reason: The player's device could not resolve the host. Roblox web APIs fail this way on a bad connection
The connection could not be established from the player's device
The request timed out on the player's connection. Roblox prints Timedout on some paths and TimedOut on others
Network-level failure on the player's device
The client aborted the request before it completed
The connection was closed mid-request by the remote side
No data arrived for long enough that the client gave up
The TLS handshake failed on the player's device
Certificate verification failed, usually a captive portal or a player-side proxy
The remote sent a response the client could not parse
The player left while a yielding group or rank lookup was in flight. The engine raises after the fact, so the game cannot prevent it

rules.match: Character cannot be changed as Player
rules.reason: The engine raises this when a character load races a player leaving

rules.match: DataStore request was added to queue
rules.reason: Roblox throttled a DataStore call and queued it. Batch requests to reduce it; queue depth is not actionable per event
Roblox CoreGui emits this on some client builds, including sessions that use no StyleLinks
